topic.original: Some political groups reject new technologies because they associate them with large corporations, but this mindset actually blocks human progress. By refusing to adopt these tools, these groups stifle innovation and prevent us from proactively solving complex problems. Instead of looking toward the future and finding ways to use technology to improve our lives, they remain stuck in a reactive state.
